thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT ALERT: routing-service: repeated fallback loop observed for customer traffic -> paging oncall. Pager sent to @oncall-anna :rotating_light:
oncall-anna: I got the page, jumping in. Quick summary?
incident-bot: Errors started ~10:12 UTC, elevated error rate + region failover chatter. Root detection: requests from eu-west hitting us-east replica variants repeatedly (latency spikes + 502s). See summarized trace in /incidents/2893456789.
eng-sre-jake: I've been watching, looks like routing policy evaluation is hitting an unexpected legacy key. Some config schema change last night removed "legacy_default_variant" but the runtime fallback code treats any non-null value as authoritative when present in older records. That mismatch is causing model variant flip/flop and region drain->failover loops.
infra-roland: Confirmed in logs:
```
2026-03-14T10:11:42Z routing-eval WARN fallback: selected_variant=redwood-3b-quant, fallback_to_region=us-east-1
2026-03-14T10:11:42Z routing-eval INFO selected_variant=redwood-3b-quant, final_route=eu-west-1 (after proxy)
2026-03-14T10:11:43Z routing-eval ERROR mismatch: legacy_default_variant present -> forcing variant remap
```
eng-sre-jake: The weird bit is some older service configs still carry the deprecated field "legacy_default_variant": "redwood-7b" even though schema now expects "default_variant". Runtime should ignore deprecated fields, but a deserialization step returns a non-empty map which the selector treats as truthy.
product-eli: Customers affected? Any active incidents reported from support?
cust-ops-sophie: A handful of customers in EU complaining about erratic latency and partial 502s since 10:10 UTC. No large-scale outage but multiple sessions degraded. I'm pooling customer IDs to follow up.
oncall-anna: Immediate mitigation plan? Can we force a global routing policy to stop honoring legacy keys?
eng-sre-jake: Quick patch available — hotfix to runtime flag to prefer "default_variant" over any legacy key and ignore deprecated fields for 24h while we run a config migration. Patch command (will roll in blue/green):
```
kubectl -n routing rollout restart deployment/routing-runtime && 
kubectl patch configmap routing-config -p '{"data":{"runtime.ignore_legacy_keys":"true"}}'
```
infra-roland: Rolling the patch to canary (eu-west-1) now. Will monitor for rollback triggers.
eng-sre-jake: Also applying immediate routing policy override to set explicit fallback policy to "regional-primary" so we don't bounce between regions:
```
redwoodctl policies set --name global-fallback --key fallback_strategy --value regional-primary --force
```
oncall-anna: Doing handoff to @eng-sre-jake for mitigation windows. I'm available for pager if things spike.
incident-bot: Pager ack from oncall-anna at 10:15 UTC.
infra-roland: Canary applied to eu-west-1; seeing steady error rate drop within two minutes. No regressions in CPU/latency.
eng-sre-jake: Patching the runtime binary was quick; now pushing config migration script to replace legacy_default_variant keys across config store. Script preview:
```
# replace deprecated key with canonical one if present
for k in $(redis-cli --scan); do
  val=$(redis-cli GET "$k" | jq '.legacy_default_variant?')
  if [ "$val" != "null" ]; then
    jq 'del(.legacy_default_variant) | .default_variant = $v' --arg v "$val" <<< "$(redis-cli GET \"$k\")" | xargs -I{} redis-cli SET "$k" '{}'
  fi
done
```
product-eli: Nice. Need ETA for full migration and rollback plan in the ticket so I can prep comms.
eng-sre-jake: ETA ~45m for full migration across configs (we'll do region-by-region). Rollback: revert the configmap key and restart routing-runtime, and set policy back to previous fallback_strategy.
cust-ops-sophie: I'll start drafting a short customer note: "We've identified a routing misconfiguration affecting variant selection for some requests in EU; mitigation underway; no data loss. We'll follow up with affected customers after remediation."
oncall-anna: Any chance this leaked into Dedicated/Private deployments?
eng-sre-jake: Good question — the migration affects central config-store used by hosted and Dedicated control-plane. Private deployments with local control plane unaffected unless they pulled the new schema and applied the migration. We'll notify SEs to check.
infra-roland: Full sweep started for all config keys in us and eu; so far 12 keys updated in eu-west canary. No error spikes.
eng-sre-jake: After 3 regional sweeps and monitoring 15m per region, we can mark mitigated. Keeping the ignore_legacy_keys flag set for 24h. Then we'll roll a minor runtime bump that fully ignores deprecated fields at deserialization time.
incident-bot: Incident severity: P2 -> mitigated (partial impact, ongoing monitoring). Pager closed at 10:29 UTC.
oncall-anna: Handoff note for next oncall: watch eu-west error rates and regional failover metric r.routing.failover.count. If it creeps +50% for 10m, re-open pager.
product-eli: Postmortem owners? Suggest eng-sre-jake (tech lead), infra-roland (deploy owner), product-eli (impact comms). Add cust-ops-sophie for customer follow-up.
cust-ops-sophie: I'll sync with support for IDs and compose follow-ups after final verification.
eng-sre-jake: I'll draft the timeline and root cause: schema migration removed field names but some configs were left with deprecated keys; runtime truthiness bug favored presence of deprecated key, causing variant selection mismatch and region thrashing. Fix: runtime guard + config cleanup + permanent deserialization change.
oncall-anna: Thanks all. I'll mark the incident handoff complete, monitoring for an hour then closing the ticket if quiet. :white_check_mark: 
eng-sre-jake: Leaving a short runbook entry: steps to mitigate variant fallback loops and commands used. Will link to ticket 2893456789.
incident-bot: Note: auto-generated follow-up questionnaire sent to assignees.
